idle.notes: gentle breathing and tiny body sway

walk_left.notes: lock planted foot; opposite arm and leg motion

walk_right.notes: independent right-facing art; never mirror left assets

dragged.notes: both legs float slightly with soft bent knees

reach.notes: slow down, bend hips and knees, reach toward task

lift.notes: both hands grip card before the body rises

carry_left.notes: task card stays between both hand anchors

carry_right.notes: task card stays between both hand anchors

put_down.notes: hands release only after the card touches the nest

celebrate.notes: small jump, bent knees, earring bounce

reminder.notes: gentle handbell shake with subtle counter-lean

constraints.footPlant: A planted foot contact anchor must remain fixed until toe-off.
constraints.gait: Arms and opposite legs swing in opposite phases; knees bend; torso bobs slightly.
constraints.startStop: Lean forward before acceleration and return upright after stopping.
constraints.taskBinding: The task card remains bound between both hand grip anchors around taskCarryAnchor.
constraints.direction: Left and right art are independent. Do not mirror assets at runtime.
